derivation.allowed_source_content: JSON source extraction displayed id/title and input/behavior/output/boundary prose, plus the same-source fields described in exposure_note. L10 case prose was read from corresponding 053 markdown sections after JSON pointer mapping.
derivation.effect_basis: Only explicit L3 obligation, L10 expected_observation/failure_observation, and L4 contracts/0..5 behavior, inputs, outputs, and boundary prose. No implementation behavior inferred.
derivation.claim_state_rule: Use supported only when the exact branch and outcome are stated by the cited requirement/case/contract. Use unknown if the branch outcome, affected scope, or applicable owner cannot be uniquely resolved from those sources; do not fill gaps from analogous leaves.
derivation.deduplication_rule: Collapse leaves only when input condition, incorrect inference, retained/held outcome, and affected scope are all identical. Keep separately named operation kinds, identity/revision axes, or independently missing authority/oracle/typed-edge components separate even where the general outcome is unknown.
unresolved_limits: No design choice for ID encoding, numbering, or persistence.
No authority transfer, acceptance, storage/rollback, or transformation operation is inferred from a record match.
No claim about L5/L8/L9 behavior or existing comparative effect rows.
derivation.exposure_note: 初期抽出でL3 requirementのparent・obligation・oracle_refとL4 contractのrefs・backflowを追加表示した。これらは同じ許可されたL3/L4 sourceの範囲内であり、既存L4 failure_classifications、対象L5/L8/L9本文・期待・比較は表示していない。

assets_read_read_only.observation: 旧A-90/ADR-004はroster/skill catalogをfilesystem正本からscan-on-demandする非entityと決定し、永続stateを持たせない。
旧automation_assetsはasset_idに加えてpath等を記録し、source/evidence pathを要求する。新053のpath非依存identityや意味revision契約と同一視しない。

failure_records_read_read_only.observation: 重複ID定義検出用lintが無いという失敗/欠陥記録。053のidentity競合条件に隣接する根拠だが、同一原因とは断定しない。
micro utility重複と実装driftの記録。資産重複・差分可視性に隣接するが、semantic lineageの直接事例とは断定しない。

legacy_comparison.preserve_and_change: 旧のpath/catalog参照と重複検出の問題を履歴証拠として保持する。新053は承認済みsource proseに従いimmutable asset IDとlocation履歴、意味revision、供給済み関係記録、unknown/holdを区別する。旧runtime/DB/schema/test/CIの機構を再利用・実行しない。直接対応する失敗原因はunknownのまま。
